description: This file contains functions for handling Exotel call integrations, including incoming, end, and missed calls, as well as managing call logs and interacting with the Exotel API.

methods.name: handle_incoming_call
methods.description: Handles incoming calls, logs call details, and manages call state.

methods.name: update_call_log
methods.description: Updates existing call log with new status and details.

methods.name: get_call_log
methods.description: Retrieves call log based on CallSid.

methods.name: create_call_log
methods.description: Creates a new call log entry.

methods.name: get_call_status
methods.description: Fetches the status of a call from Exotel API.

methods.name: make_a_call
methods.description: Initiates a call via Exotel API.

methods.name: get_exotel_endpoint
methods.description: Constructs API endpoint URL for Exotel.
